Approvals.title: Approvals
Approvals.ownRequest: Your own request — another person must decide.
Approvals.subtitle: Payments over the limit and write-offs wait here. Nobody approves their own request.

Verify.title: Documents to verify
Verify.empty: No documents are waiting for verification.
Verify.subtitle: Check each received document against the original, then verify or reject it.

Setup.title: Setup
Setup.intro: Configure how the company works. Every change is recorded in the audit trail.
Setup.addMoneyAccount: Add a cash box or bank account
Setup.postingHelp: Which ledger account each automatic posting uses. If one is not set, that operation is refused instead of guessing.
Setup.limitsHelp: Payments above these amounts (same payee, same day added together) need a second person's approval. Leave empty for no limit.
Setup.transitDays: Alert when a loaded trip is not discharged after
Setup.addJobType: Add or update a job type
Setup.ratesHelp: Prices, fees, allowances and demurrage. A rule applies from its start date; the rule in force on a trip's loading date is used and kept with the trip.
Setup.roundingHelp: Final amounts paid or billed are rounded to the nearest multiple (e.g. 250 IQD).
Setup.contractsHelp: Optional. Small or one-off work needs neither; link a job to a contract or project only when it helps.
Setup.defaultActivities: Checklist steps for new jobs (one per line, optional)
Setup.defaultActivitiesHelp:
e.g.
Arrange truck
Load
Deliver
Collect manifest
Invoice customer
Setup.customFieldsHelp: Extra information some customers or kinds of work need (customer reference, permit number, site code). Use only for simple facts — anything used in calculations or reports should become a real field.
Setup.addCustomField: Add or change a custom field
Setup.accountsHelp: The chart of accounts. Each account can be limited to one currency.
Setup.documentRulesHelp: Which documents are required, for which job type, customer or contract, and before which step.
Setup.endContractConfirm: End this contract? New jobs can no longer use it.
Setup.jobTypesHelp: A job type gives new jobs their default parts and steps. Users can still change them on each job.
Setup.moneyAccountsHelp: Safes and bank accounts that money is paid from or received into.
Setup.noneContracts: No contracts yet. Contracts are optional.
Setup.noneProjects: No projects yet. Projects are optional.
Setup.partnersHelp: Customers, suppliers, transporters, drivers and contractors. One partner can have several roles.
Setup.projectsHelp: Group several jobs of one customer under a project.
Setup.transitDaysHelp: Expected days between loading and discharge; trips taking longer are shown as delayed.

Finance.title: Invoices & payments
Finance.subtitle: What customers still owe us and what we still owe suppliers. Open an invoice to see its lines and payments.

Settle.title: Settlement and billing
Settle.settleConfirm: Settle {trip}? The trip will be locked and the amounts posted to the books.

Statements.title: Pay statements
Statements.intro: Put settled trips on one statement to pay several drivers together, or a transporter for all its trips. Every trip is shown with its full calculation.
Statements.noneWaiting: No settled trips are waiting for a statement.
Statements.payOnly: Pay only these (leave all unticked to pay everyone not yet paid)
Statements.collectHelp: If the payee pays back now (all or part), record it here. Anything not paid back is deducted automatically from their next statement.
Statements.writeOffHelp: Only if the money cannot be recovered (e.g. the driver no longer works with us). This always needs approval and is booked as a cost.
Statements.debtsHelp: Advances were larger than pay. Each amount is deducted from the payee's next statement automatically, unless it is paid back or written off first.
Statements.pickTrips: Tick the trips to pay together, then create the statement.

Reports.title: Reports
Reports.jobProfitHelp: Revenue minus direct costs of each job in the period, from the books. Each currency is shown separately.
Reports.monthlyHelp: All income and costs of the company per month (with or without a job).
Reports.subtitle: Profit by job and month, the profit and loss statement and the balance sheet — each currency on its own.

Activities.title: Steps
Activities.requiredHelp: Must be done before the job can be completed
Activities.noneHint: Add the steps this job goes through, if it helps.

Supply.title: Deliveries
Supply.billHelp: Price comes from Setup → rates (product price). Type a price only for products without a price rule.
Supply.priceIfNoRule: Unit price (only if no price rule)

Accounts.title: Cash, bank and books
Accounts.transferHelp: Same currency only (e.g. bank → safe). To change USD into IQD use Currency exchange.
Accounts.otherHelp: Money that is not an invoice, advance, expense or statement — e.g. owner deposit, bank charges, miscellaneous income.
Accounts.tbHelp: Every account with movements, per currency. Total debits equal total credits in each currency.
Accounts.periodsHelp: A locked month accepts no new postings — lock a month after its accounts are checked.
Accounts.subtitle: Money in each safe and bank account, money movements between them, the trial balance and month locks.

Journal.title: Journal
Journal.intro: Every posting in the books. Entries are never edited: a mistake is corrected by a reversal. Entries made by invoices, payments or settlements are corrected from those screens.
Journal.manualHelp: For accountants: each currency must balance (debits = credits).

Exchange.title: Currency exchange
Exchange.intro: Record USD sold for IQD (or the other way) at the rate you actually got. The rate is stored and never recalculated.

PartnerAccounts.title: Partner accounts
PartnerAccounts.intro: Open balances with customers, suppliers, drivers and transporters, per currency.

Perm.jobs_manage: Run jobs (status, steps, work orders, deliveries)
Perm.settlements_create: Settle trips and make pay statements
Perm.settlements_reverse: Reverse settlements, cancel statements, write off
Perm.job_terms_manage: Set job rules (prices, allowances, fees, advance limits)
Perm.profit_view: See profit, margins and customer prices

Admin.title: Users and roles
Admin.name: Name
Admin.addUserHelp: They receive an e-mail to choose a password. Give them a role after adding them.
Admin.rolesHelp: A role is a set of permissions. Every action is checked on the server.
Admin.defineRoleHelp: You can only give permissions you have yourself (greyed out otherwise).
Admin.auditHelp: Every change in the system, who made it and why. It cannot be edited or deleted.
Admin.subtitle: Who can use the system and what each role may do.

Jobs.title: Jobs
Jobs.subtitle: Every piece of work, from a single delivery to a long field project.
Jobs.noneHint: Change the filters or create a new job.
Jobs.newSubtitle: Only the basics. Everything else is added to the job when it is needed.
Jobs.namePlaceholder: e.g. Diesel to Field X, Supply 10 generators
Jobs.typesHelp: The type switches on the usual parts and steps; you can change them on the job.

Library.title: Documents
Library.subtitle: Every manifest, delivery note, invoice and certificate in one place — find it by job, trip, partner or type.
Library.noneHint: Try another status or clear the search.
Library.fileLabel: PDF or photo, up to 15 MB

Search.title: Search
Search.hint: Type at least two letters in the search box above.

Search.nothingHint: Search by job or trip number, a partner's name, an invoice number, a truck plate or a document reference.

Welcome.title: Set up Evercrest
Welcome.intro: This page appears only once, before the system has a company. It creates the company, you as administrator with every permission, and the starting configuration. You choose your password here and sign in straight away.
Welcome.err_code: The setup code is not correct.
Welcome.err_fields: Fill in every field with a valid e-mail.
Welcome.err_already: The system is already set up. Sign in instead.
Welcome.err_failed: Setup did not finish. Check the Supabase settings and try again.
Welcome.doneInvited: Done. An invitation is on its way to {email}: open it and choose your password.
Welcome.doneNoInvite: Done, but the invitation e-mail could not be sent. Use “Forgot your password?” with {email}.
Welcome.err_weak: The password needs at least 10 characters.
Welcome.err_mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
Welcome.doneReady: Done. Sign in with {email} and the password you chose.

Rules.noRulesTitle: This job has no rules yet
Rules.noRulesHelp: Set the prices, the shortage allowance and fine, and the fees. Every trip is then calculated from them automatically.
Rules.termsHelp: Each version applies from its date. A change is a new version; older trips keep the old one.
Rules.advanceMaxHint: above it, your approval is needed
Rules.customerPriceHint: leave empty while the price is still to be decided
Rules.netQty: net quantity (lower of loaded and discharged)
Rules.dem_arrival_to_discharge: days between arrival and discharge (both excluded)
Rules.carrierDemurrage: Paid to the carrier per day
Rules.customerDemurrage: Charged to the customer per day
Rules.routesHelp: Where trucks load and discharge. A route can have its own prices and fees.
Rules.noRoutes: No routes yet; they are also created from imported sheets.
Rules.feesHelp: Visa, insurance, guarantee, customs… Each fee says whether it is taken from the carrier and whether the customer pays it.
Rules.zeroEnds: 0 ends the fee from this date
Rules.billedToCustomer: Charged to the customer on top of the price
Rules.newFeeTypeHelp: A new kind of fee the company meets (e.g. exchanger financing fee). Then set its amount on the job.

Trips.title: Trips
Trips.estimatedHint: not discharged yet — figures are estimates
Trips.withoutRulesTitle: {count} trips have no rule for their date or route
Trips.withoutRulesHelp: Add a version in Rules that covers them; they will be calculated at once.
Trips.noTripsHint: Import the loading sheet (.xlsx) or start a trip by hand.
Trips.noRuleForTrip: No rule covers this trip's date and route
Trips.flag_fee_other_currency: a fee is in another currency
Trips.flag_advance_other_currency: an advance is in another currency
Trips.allSubtitle: Every trip of every job. Filter, sort and search like a spreadsheet; totals follow the filtered rows.
Trips.enterTripsHelp: type one row per truck, Tab to the next cell; the date, route, price and transporter copy down
Trips.rowsReady: {count, plural, =0 {no rows yet} one {# row ready} other {# rows ready}}
Trips.gridHint: Enter moves down, Tab at the end adds a row

Import.title: Import trip sheet
Import.subtitle: {rows} rows read for {sheet}
Import.uploadHelp: The loading sheet as the site keeps it (.xlsx). Only typed-in columns are read; calculated columns are ignored because the system calculates them itself.
Import.err_too_large: The file is larger than 10 MB.
Import.updatesHint: known manifests getting their discharge data
Import.errorsHint: skipped; fix the sheet and import again
Import.newNamesHelp: They will be created. Check the spelling: a name written differently becomes a second record.
Import.applyConfirm: Create the trips, drivers and advances from this sheet? Rows with errors are skipped.
Import.paidFromHint: the cash box the site paid the drivers from
Import.applyHelp: Each advance is recorded as a payment from that box on the trip's loading date. Rows marked unchanged or error are skipped.
Import.note_manifest_twice_in_file: This manifest appears twice in the sheet
Import.note_transport_not_enabled: Transportation is not enabled for this job
Import.note_loaded_not_positive: Loaded quantity must be above zero
Import.note_discharge_before_loading: Discharge date is before the loading date
Import.note_discharge_date_missing: Discharged quantity without a discharge date
Import.note_advances_not_enabled: Advances are not enabled for this job
Import.note_no_rule_card: No rule covers this date and route; the trip will show without figures until one is added
Import.note_advance_above_max: Advance {sheet} is above the rule card's limit ({max}) — raise the limit on the rule card or approve it separately
Import.note_fee_not_on_rule_card: Fee “{fee}” {sheet} is not on the rule card
Import.note_differs_discharged: Recorded discharged {recorded}, sheet says {sheet} — not changed
Import.note_differs_discharge_date: Recorded discharge date {recorded}, sheet says {sheet} — not changed
Import.note_differs_loaded: Recorded loaded {recorded}, sheet says {sheet} — not changed
Import.note_advance_needs_approval: Advance {sheet} is above the company's payment limit ({limit}) and the rule card sets no advance limit — set one on the rule card or approve it separately
